title: Ali's House
text:
My friend Ali has a small house in a quiet village. The house is white, and it has a red door. There is a big garden with many trees behind the house.

In the garden, there is a small pond. Ali's dog likes to swim there in the summer. The kitchen is yellow and warm, and it is Ali's favorite room.

questions.text: What color is the door of Ali's house?
How does Ali probably feel about his house?
options: He does not like the kitchen
He is afraid of the dog

questions.text: Why does the dog probably enjoy the garden in summer?
options: It has a pond where it can swim

vocabulary.definition: an area of land outside a house where plants and trees grow
a small area of still water

paragraph_translations: Arkadaşım Ali, sessiz bir köyde küçük bir evde yaşıyor. Ev beyaz ve kırmızı bir kapısı var. Evin arkasında birçok ağacın olduğu büyük bir bahçe var.
Bahçede küçük bir gölet var. Ali'nin köpeği yazın orada yüzmeyi seviyor. Mutfak sarı ve sıcak, ve Ali'nin en sevdiği oda burası.
